mapper.select: select submit_user_id as user_id, count(*) as `count` from oj_lesson_paper_evaluate where submit_user_id in #{user_id} and lesson_id in and (level = 1 or level = 2) group by user_id ;

select count(distinct T1.course_id) as finish_course_count, count(if(T2.type = #{theory_type}, 1, NULL )) as finish_theory_count, count(if(T2.type = #{exp_type}, 1, NULL )) as finish_exp_count from oj_lesson_record T1 left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.lesson_id = T2.resource_id where T1.user_id = #{user_id} and T1.lesson_id in (select resource_id from oj_course_lesson);

select count(distinct T1.resource_id) as course_count, count(if(T2.type = #{theory_type}, 1, NULL )) as theory_count, count(if(T2.type = #{exp_type}, 1, NULL )) as exp_count from oj_course T1 left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.course_id;

select count(T1.resource_id) as practice_count, count(if(T3.id, 1 ,NULL )) as finish_practice_count from oj_paper T1 left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.paper_id left join oj_lesson_paper_evaluate T3 on T2.resource_id = T3.lesson_id and T3.submit_user_id = #{user_id} and (T3.level = 1 or T3.level = 2) where T1.type = #{paper_type} and T1.practice_count > 0 and T1.resource_id in (select paper_id from oj_course_lesson);

select T1.resource_id, T1.name, R1.name as direction_name, T1.difficulty, T1.logo, (select count(*) from oj_course_lesson where course_id = T1.resource_id) as lesson_count, count(case when T2.type = #{theory_type} then 1 end) as learned_theory, count(case when T2.type = #{exp_type} then 1 end) as learned_exp, count(T3.id) as learned_exp_report, count(T4.id) as learned_after_class_practice, T5.lesson_id, T5.learned_type, T5.room_id, T5.update_time as create_time from oj_course T1 left join oj_course_category R1 on T1.category_id = R1.resource_id left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.course_id left join oj_note T3 on T2.resource_id = T3.business_id and T3.note_type = #{report_code} and T3.user_id = #{user_id} left join oj_lesson_paper_evaluate T4 on T2.resource_id = T4.lesson_id and T4.submit_user_id = #{user_id} and (T4.level = 1 or T4.level = 2) left join ( select r.course_id, r.lesson_id, r.update_time, r.learned_type, r.room_id from oj_lesson_record r where r.user_id = #{user_id} and r.id = ( select r2.id from oj_lesson_record r2 where r2.user_id = r.user_id and r2.course_id = r.course_id order by r2.update_time desc limit 1 ) ) as T5 on T5.course_id = T1.resource_id where T2.resource_id in (select lesson_id from oj_lesson_record where user_id = #{user_id}) group by T1.resource_id, T1.name, R1.name, T1.difficulty, T1.logo, T5.lesson_id, T5.learned_type, T5.room_id, T5.update_time

SELECT r.user_id as user_id, sum(case when l.type = 0 then 3 else 5 end) as integral from oj_lesson_record r left join oj_course_lesson l on l.resource_id = r.lesson_id where r.lesson_id in (select resource_id from oj_course_lesson) and r.create_time >= #{start_time} and r.create_time <= #{end_time} and r.user_id in #{user_id} and r.lesson_id in group by r.user_id
